mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in Brooklin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brooklin is part of the Town of Whitby. An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. We check before you order.

mainEntity.name: Which sauna suits a family of five?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Pure Cube 672 seats four to five and the Neptune five to six. Both run on a 6 to 10.5 kW electric heater sized to the room.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Brooklin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Brooklin. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
